dedupe_keys.name: probait anonymised mobile user equipment packet traces

description: ProBait records packet-level user-plane behaviour from ten mobile devices connected to 4G and 5G services across five operators. The maintainers collected packet captures with handset tools and converted them to CSV, reporting anonymised source and destination addresses. Each device has idle and mixed-activity traces; mobile examples cover bus, car and subway travel, while other devices remain stationary. Documented fields include relative packet time, protocol, packet size and a limited information field. Geographic coverage, exact collection dates and the time-unit convention are not established in the README; real timestamps were removed. CSV files are public and free under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is the small device sample and the absence of a directly labelled control-plane event record. The provider’s suggested inference of control events from user-plane patterns requires validation. Simulation uses include fitting packet-arrival patterns and comparing mobility-dependent traffic scenarios. No related catalogue dataset was identified as the same collection. The privacy and collection claims were read as provider statements; no packet data was downloaded and no claim of representative national operator performance is made.
name: ProBait anonymised mobile user-equipment packet traces
